items.title: Color Works Only through Contrast
items.zh_title: 色彩只有靠对比才有效
items.zh_oneliner: 商品页配色讲对比，视觉层次比颜色本身重要。
items.en_oneliner: Product-page color works through contrast; visual hierarchy matters more than the colors themselves.

items.title: Subscription churn: Turn retention insights into recurring revenue growth
items.zh_title: 订阅流失：把留存洞察变成持续收入增长
items.zh_oneliner: 订阅业务的增长关键在留存，不在拉新。
items.en_oneliner: For subscription businesses, growth hinges on retention rather than new customer acquisition.
